ChatAssistant.name: StyleMatch Assistant
ChatAssistant.dragHint: Drag me anywhere · Tap to chat
ChatAssistant.welcome: Hi! I’m your shopping assistant. I can help you find the right product, compare options, check delivery details, or answer order questions.
ChatAssistant.placeholder: Ask about products, delivery, or returns…
ChatAssistant.error: I couldn’t reach the shopping service just now. Please try again in a moment.
ChatAssistant.rateLimited: You’re sending messages too quickly. Please wait a moment and try again.
ChatAssistant.dailyQuota: The assistant’s daily message allowance has been reached. Please try again tomorrow.
ChatAssistant.serviceBusy: The assistant is handling several requests right now. Please try again in a few seconds.
ChatAssistant.disclaimer: AI assistant · Please verify important order details

responses.findStyle: I’d love to help. Tell me what you need, your budget, and any must-have features—and I’ll narrow down the right products for you.
responses.delivery: Standard delivery is free on orders over $50. Delivery timing and any faster options are shown at checkout for your address.
responses.returns: You can return eligible items within 30 days. Keep the product unused and in its original packaging, then visit Shipping & Returns for the steps.
responses.fallback: Thanks for your message. This assistant is currently in preview mode, so I can guide you around the store but can’t access live products or orders yet.
